rationale: SRAD has gapped up ~14.5% on no identifiable news catalyst, which creates significant uncertainty about whether this is a sustained move or a fade setup. The last 5 one-minute candles show extremely tight, low-volume consolidation just below the 9-EMA with no clear directional momentum — price is coiling without a breakout trigger in either direction. With the stock already 74% through today's range and no news to anchor a thesis, the risk/reward for either a long continuation or a short fade is unclear, making a skip the prudent choice.
